tasks.label: Run interactive CP/M emulator
tasks.detail: Check all four disks/512kb images with read-only fsck.cpm before refreshing A or starting CP/M; abort on failure. CP/M edits persist in these base disks. Ctrl+C stops the session; stop it before building or copying.

tasks.label: Build Apple container
tasks.detail: Build the shared container image and host audio client. Does not start CP/M, build applications, or copy disks.

tasks.label: Altair: Build apps and copy disks to Z80 SBC
tasks.detail: Stop both emulators first. Build/install applications in disks/512kb, preserving unrelated files, then overwrite the SBC's four native disks. Built application files are replaced.

tasks.label: Altair: Copy current disks to Z80 SBC
tasks.detail: Stop both emulators first. Copy disks/512kb to the SBC's native disk folder without rebuilding applications. Overwrites all four destination disks, including D's database.

tasks.label: Build active DCC C file for debugging
tasks.command: if [[ -f dccmake.txt ]]; then "${env:DCC_DIR}/dccmake" -g; else "${env:DCC_DIR}/dccmake" -g "dcc-input=${file}" "dcc-output=${fileBasenameNoExtension}" "dcc-include-directory=${env:DCC_DIR}" "l80-command=${env:DCC_DIR}/l80c.com" 'dcc-runtime=${DCC_DIR}/DCCRTL.MAC' dcc-build-dir=build; fi

tasks.label: Copy debug outputs back to source folder
tasks.command: if [[ -f dccmake.txt ]]; then output_base=$(sed -n 's/^[[:space:]]*dcc-output[[:space:]]*=[[:space:]]*//p' dccmake.txt | tail -1); fi; if [[ -z "${output_base}" ]]; then output_base="${fileBasenameNoExtension}"; fi; output_base=$(printf '%s' "${output_base}" | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]') && cp -f "${fileDirname}/build/${output_base}.COM" "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.COM" && cp -f "${fileDirname}/build/${output_base}.DBG" "${fileDirname}/${fileBasenameNoExtension}.DBG"

tasks.label: Build and copy active DCC C file for debugging
dependsOn: Build active DCC C file for debugging
Copy debug outputs back to source folder

tasks.label: Build active DCC file for full CP/M debugging
dependsOn: Build and copy active DCC C file for debugging
